per_candidate.id: s2:A hot-Jupiter progenitor on a super-eccentric retrograde orbit

supporting_ids: s2:A hot-Jupiter progenitor on a super-eccentric retrograde orbit
rationale: The papers 'Tides in the high-eccentricity migration of hot Jupiters' (2104.04929) and 'TOI-3362b: A Proto-Hot Jupiter Undergoing High-Eccentricity Tidal Migration' (2109.03771) investigate high-eccentricity migration mechanisms, while 'A hot-Jupiter progenitor on a super-eccentric retrograde orbit' provides evidence for a specific formation scenario, contributing to the understanding of hot Jupiter migration.
